palisade_zone.kind: explicit anastomotic NETWORK, not a CCO tree — Murray's law does not apply to a non-dichotomous plexus and no Murray residual is reported for it
palisade_zone.placement: submucosal radius = measured inscribed radius - 0.9 mm (published mucosa + muscularis mucosae depth)
palisade_zone.significance: the palisade zone is the watershed where the PORTAL territory (left gastric vein, V3) meets the SYSTEMIC territory (azygos, V2). In portal hypertension flow in V3 reverses (hepatofugal) and decompresses through these longitudinal channels into the azygos, dilating them into oesophageal varices.

node_displacement_repair.movable: free bifurcation and adventitial-terminal nodes only; roots and the azygos trunk are fixed

clearance_audit.note: anatomical fidelity was given priority over any fixed gap threshold. Companion artery and vein in a shared periesophageal adventitial sheath are separated by far less than 1 mm in life, so the solver target was set to 0.05 mm and the measured minimum (0.0212 mm, left gastric artery vs left gastric vein) is reported as found. Two of the 21 pairs sit exactly at the 0.05 mm solver target and are flagged at_solver_target: those two numbers are a property of the solver, not an independent measurement of the geometry.

totals.unattached_note: these targets were NOT silently dropped. Each is an adventitial sampling point for which no bifurcation site existed inside the periesophageal corridor that also satisfied the 0.05 mm clearance against the already-grown trees.
